PELLUCID AI SERVICES ADDENDUM
SYNTHETIC EVAL SAMPLE: fictional vendor, written for testing. Not a real agreement.

1. Order of Precedence. This Addendum controls over any website content, FAQ, or documentation.

2. Definitions. "Service Data" means usage data, telemetry, and Inputs and Outputs as processed by the Service.

3. Use of Service Data. Pellucid may use Service Data to develop, maintain, and improve the Service and its underlying models.

4. Zero Data Retention. On Enterprise plans, Customer may enable zero data retention, in which case Pellucid does not store Inputs or Outputs after processing.

5. Deletion. Pellucid deletes all Inputs and Outputs no later than the date this Addendum terminates.

6. Subprocessors. Pellucid lists its subprocessors on its trust site, provides 30 days' advance notice of changes, and Customer may object and terminate if Pellucid proceeds over the objection.

7. Ownership. Customer owns Outputs.

8. Confidentiality. Inputs and Outputs are Customer's Confidential Information.

9. Security. Pellucid maintains a SOC 2 Type II report and will notify Customer within 72 hours of a breach affecting Customer data.

10. Indemnity. Pellucid's intellectual property indemnity covers the Service. It does not apply to Outputs.
